correctness.rationale: Finite exact orbit-simplex construction verifies each of 29 nontrivial subgroup geometric fixed-space inclusions through 42/2/0 free-face collapse certificates. Every one of the 2122 link faces and all 1049 acyclic augmented matching pairs are constructed and topologically sorted. Relative integral homology is Z^96 in degree 4. Equivariant Euler--Poincaré then gives relative rational S4-character 96 at identity, 0 elsewhere: four regular modules. Algorithmic exhaustive coverage follows from enumerating all orbit subsets and all subgroup generators, not from test logs.

value.rationale: Equivariant behavior of a canonical inclusion is a structurally motivated problem for Scoville's new tetrahedral Morse-complex comparison. The full-to-boundary inclusion is not a nonequivariant homotopy equivalence yet induces elementary collapses on all nontrivial subgroup fixed sets. The resulting four regular rational S4 summands contain information beyond the previously known rank 96 and the full complex's absolute 99-dimensional rational character.
